description: This file is a Perl module defining functions for reading, writing, comparing, and managing Git packet data over a stream, including capabilities negotiation.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists of strings for equality.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returns a status and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes a trailing LF from a buffer or dies if not present.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, decodes it, and removes trailing LF.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key=value line, verifies the key, and returns the value.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT, appending LF.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes current packets by writing a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the packet stream with client/server handshake.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the remote endpoint.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and verifies required capabilities are supported.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks local capabilities against remote ones and advertises supported capabilities.
